title: Linear footer
description: A quiet footer under a full-width hairline: a small brand mark in the first of six columns, then five groups of grey 13px links under white medium-weight headings, and a dim legal row beneath. Links brighten on hover. On phones the groups pair up in two columns and the legal links become a group of their own.
notes: five groups fill the desktop row; the brand mark is hidden on phones, as on the original
